Estimates and site terms.

Scope, costing assumptions, and disclosures for consulting services and software comparisons.

Estimates and agreements

Prices and calculator totals are USD planning estimates. A technical assessment and agreed statement of work determine fees, availability requirements, support coverage and deliverables. Optional maintenance and third-party costs are separate unless specified in that agreement.

Software and trademarks

Open-source components remain subject to their respective licenses. Commercial plan comparisons describe potential workflow alternatives. Product names belong to their respective trademark owners. Anthony Bluemel is independent of the vendors listed. Verify current vendor terms, fees and edition capabilities before purchase.

Shared responsibilities

Customer-hosted systems incur expenses for compute or hardware, power, storage, networking, backups and administration. Availability depends on the design, dependencies, workload compatibility and tested recovery procedures. Direct questions to antblu@antblu.net.
